opportunities.title: JadePuffer Doesn't Just Steal Your Cloud — It Deletes It: Inside the First 'Destructive' AI Agent Attack on Azure
opportunities.why_now: A named AI threat actor autonomously compromised and destroyed Azure tenant resources, marking an escalation from data theft to agentic sabotage.
opportunities.angle: Breach breakdown + threat-actor profile: what JadePuffer did, how it moved, and why 'AI agent as attacker' changes the incident-response playbook.

opportunities.title: Your Docker Host Now Has a Telegram-Controlled AI Agent Living In It (Meet Hermes)

opportunities.angle: Threat-actor deep dive: how Carbonato works, what Hermes does once installed, and why 'malware with an AI brain' is the next botnet evolution.

opportunities.title: ShinyHunters' Arrest Won't Stop the Bleeding: Google Flags Fresh Oracle PeopleSoft Campaign Same Week

opportunities.title: 16,000+ Supabase Apps Are Leaking Passwords and Auth Tokens Right Now — Check Yours
